$comment: Patterns of the repeated-values check (GEN-18, scripts/pipeline/lib/analysis/repeats.mjs) for TypeScript and JavaScript. `defaults` read a configuration source (config modules, `.env.example`; JSON files are read as JSON); `constants` read every source file (UPPER_SNAKE names); `fallbacks` are matched on changed lines. {literal} is a number or a quoted string. Named groups: key/value, name/value, expr/value. `comments` matches a whole-line comment, whose literals are prose and are not checked.
